description: [Approved mode — write] This tool creates a record in Pushizo. It only creates a DRAFT and never sends or schedules a message; the API key needs the `mcp:write` scope. Get explicit approval from the user before calling it. Creates a dynamic segment (no effect until used in a campaign). Definition format: {"all":[{"field":"tags.plan","op":"eq","value":"pro"},{"field":"last_active_at","op":"within_days","value":30}]}.

app_id.description: App ID (app_…). Not needed with an app-scoped key or when a default app is configured.
